description: WeWrite Table is an advanced Power BI visual that offers direct data writeback capabilities. By integrating data entry within Power BI, you can say goodbye to Excel headaches and hello to a more streamlined, efficient, and effective data ecosystem. WeWrite integrates data entry within your Power BI reports. Design intuitive data entry forms that facilitate direct input, saving precious time and improving data accuracy. This functionality enhances efficiency and ensures that your data remains consistent and up-to-date. Enhancing your data management practices, WeWrite Visual ensures that your data is stored securely in a proper database. This means your data becomes a valuable asset that can be utilized across various Power BI reports, applications, or even AI models. Supported databases: Microsoft SQL on-premises/cloud Azure SQL Fabric Warehouse MySQL PostgreSQL Snowflake If you have a specific database that you want to writeback to and it is not on our list, send us a feature request HERE. Supported features: Insert/delete row Adjust data -> numbers, text or date Row level comments Locking columns Dynamic or static dropdown Edit mode Quick calculations (absolute and relative) Power BI native-like design Row Level Security Audit logs Custom scripts POPULAR USE CASES: Data entry forms (no more Excel helper tables) Cash flow planning (extraordinary payables, receivables) Status…
